name: Golden Teacher
summary: Common cubensis strain. Reference conditions for research and education only.
notes: Informational climate only. Not a cultivation guide for illegal activity.
chamber_notes: Cubensis typically uses a tub/casing workflow the Shrooly does not replace. This only covers humidity, temperature, light, and fresh air.
legal_notice: Psilocybin mushrooms are illegal to grow, possess, or sell in most countries and under US federal law. This information is published for educational, research and harm-reduction purposes only. Check the laws where you live. Shroom Labs does not sell spores, cultures or psilocybin products.

source_notes.title: Climate
source_notes.detail: P. cubensis colonizes at about 24 to 27 °C, then pins and fruits at about 21 to 24 °C with high humidity and 12 hours of light a day.

source_notes.title: Practice
source_notes.detail: Fresh air goes up at pinning. The surface should show fine droplets, not standing water.

stages.name: Colonization
stages.notes: Dark, still. Do not add fresh air early.

light_recipe.why: P. cubensis needs light to start pins, and blue light works for that. Colonization is dark. Pinning and fruiting get 12 hours a day at 20% white (92 lux on this chamber) with 80% blue.
light_recipe.wavelength_note: WS2812 blue is roughly 465 to 475 nm. The RGB mix is an approximation, not a measured spectrum.

sources.title: Chamber default
sources.detail: Standard light settings mapped to this chamber's white and RGB LEDs. Not a measured value for this variety.
